document.title: Betway Betting Rules, Version 42, 'These terms were last updated 10/02/2022'
document.supplied: by the maintainer as BettingRules.pdf on 2026-10-25; copy kept (gitignored, in the daily backup) at .prop_alpha_state/analysis/bookmaker_rules/betway_betting_rules_v42_2022-02-10.pdf
caveats: Dated 10 February 2022 (version 42): whether it is the version in force today is not confirmed.

It names no licensee or website ('The operator'); stakes in GBP/EUR and UK broadcasters suggest Betway's UK/international site. Whether OddsPapi's 'betway' prices are that operator's is not confirmed.
It names no statistics provider: player markets settle on 'feed provided data', else Betway's own statistics.
The tackle definition does not say whether a tackle after which the ball goes straight back to an opponent counts.

rules.url_or_document: Betway Betting Rules v42 (10/02/2022), p.51 'Tackles (Team/Selected Player)' and p.49 'Player Performance'
rules.wording: p.51: a tackle is where a player "connects with the ball in ground challenge where he successfully takes the ball away" from the man in possession, who must clearly be in possession. p.49: settled on feed-provided data; with no official source or significant conflicting evidence, on Betway's own statistics (provider not named).

rules.url_or_document: Betway Betting Rules v42 (10/02/2022), p.49 'Player Performance'
rules.wording: p.49: player performance markets are on the result at the end of regular time including stoppage time, and "does not include extra time", a penalty shootout or a golden goal.

rules.url_or_document: Betway Betting Rules v42 (10/02/2022), p.49 'Player Performance'
rules.wording: p.49: "Propositions markets specifically, players must start for bets to stand." (A player who does not start: void. The document does not list which markets are 'propositions'; the tackles market sits under the same Player Performance heading.)

rules.url_or_document: Betway Betting Rules v42 (10/02/2022), p.49 'Player Performance' and p.30 'Soccer - General'
rules.wording: p.49: bets on a match "abandoned before the completion of the regular time will be void" except markets already unconditionally determined. p.30: a match not played on the scheduled date (local time) is void.

missing_rules: whole-line settlement: the document gives the push rule only for goals over/under (p.33-34: a total exactly on a whole line returns the stake); nothing for player markets. The pilot's Betway tackles markets are 'k+' ladders, which have no whole line.
